rv.q: I cannot think of a better choice than going to see the musical 'Come From Away' at the Marriott Theatre in Lincolnshire.
The Marriott Theatre’s production is as good as any I’ve seen, as good as it gets.
COME FROM AWAY is a positive, uplifting, brilliantly written and professionally performed musical with a great score that’s set up by the appalling events of that day.
This show is electric, inspiring and fits the Marriott Theatre’s in-the-round-stage like a glove.

Marriott Theatre ’s production, directed by Jessica Fisch and choreographed by Katie Spelman , stages it in the round, inviting the audience in as “come-from-aways” (the Gander phrase for a traveler or visitor) and bringing us closer to the characters and their story.
There is little in the production that does not feel genuine and immediate.
Directed with characteristic warmth by Jessica Fisch, Marriott's production was funnier than others I've experienced.
Marriott Theatre’s production of Come From Away offers a thoughtfully crafted, emotionally grounded evening that earns its place among the company’s stronger musical offerings.
It's an incredible, non-stop performance that's truly a "Must See," transforming a historical tragedy into an uplifting story of triumph and love...
This production will blow you away and make you feel that you are one of the locals reaching out to aid in the time of need.
The new production of Come From Away at Marriott Theatre is charming, funny, heartbreaking, and beautifully paced.
Our extraordinary neighbors to the North welcomed stranded strangers with heart-warming, soul-stirring, grand receptions.
